scope: declarative finite challenge suite; not exhaustive enumeration or independent statistical samples

cases.notes: Unchanged operation must reach the sink once.
Identical tool names and bytes do not make host server identities interchangeable.
Object key order alone does not revoke the selected operation.
An unpublished caller-owned mutation must not change the admitted or dispatched snapshot.
The selected descriptor is withdrawn before prepare; no fresh approval is given.
Restoring equal bytes does not restore an approval revoked by withdrawal.
A revoked approval remains revoked after a change-and-revert.
The original approved request, not the later caller dictionary, is dispatched.
The same single-use approval may produce only one dispatch receipt.
The stale older completion cannot publish or revoke the unchanged latest-requested catalogue.
The stale older result must not resurrect an approval revoked by the accepted newer result.
Array order is preserved in the full descriptor contract; semantic schema equivalence is not assumed.
A later refresh cannot retroactively invalidate a correctly enqueued request.
Harmless refreshes preserve the operation but do not reset single-use consumption.
